sections.heading: 1. Three easy steps
lines: ① Sit up with a pillow behind your lower back too.
② Rest the book on a pillow, closer to eye level.
③ Every 20 minutes, do 5 slow chin tucks.
④ Getting sleepy? Put it down and lie flat.

caption:
Momo reads in bed for an hour every night, propped up on pillows. Lately her neck feels stiff every morning.

Reading while lying back often keeps the head tipped forward for a long time. Supporting your lower back with a pillow, resting the book on a pillow closer to eye level, and doing 5 slow chin tucks every 20 minutes can ease the load on your neck.

Headaches, arm tingling, or stiffness lasting more than two weeks are worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 📚

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
